title: Oakpale
html_source: Again, Mulligan’s complexion evokes the wood of the Trojan horse.

anchor.prefix:
The bard's noserag! A new art colour for our Irish poets: snotgreen. You can almost taste it, can't you? 

 He mounted to the parapet again and gazed out over Dublin bay, his fair
anchor.suffix:
hair stirring slightly. 

 — God! he said quietly. Isn't the sea what Algy calls it: a great sweet mother? The snotgreen sea. The scrotumtightening sea. Epi oinopa ponton. Ah, Ded
